title: Glass Steppe: Settlement Survival

foundation.history: The shattered outpost was built to protect ceramic heat tiles, but glass-shard gales interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Iri Bell, a builder, must establish a resilient shelter network using needs and crafting while glass-shard gales threatens the shattered outpost.
central_conflict: an approaching storm seeks control of ceramic heat tiles; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: glass-shard gales isolates the shattered outpost
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: an approaching storm offers privileged access to ceramic heat tiles
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
